sector_definition: Three fixed issuer samples, equal member and dimension weight. Not a whole-industry nine-dimensional score. No financial/business gate replacement by prices.
normalization: 100*clamp((value-low)/(high-low),0,1); reversed anchors intentionally inverse; Decimal 40 significant digits, HALF_EVEN, score display 4 decimals; no missing fill or weight renormalization
financial_definition: Consolidated FY2025 revenue/FY2024 revenue-1; consolidated FY2025 CFO/consolidated net profit (profit must be positive); consolidated net profit/revenue. All numerator/denominator same currency/units/consolidation and period; restated comparator from same current report, not historical original.

stock_rules.fundamental: mean of three financial component scores; all three required
stock_rules.sector_benefit: sector total * disclosed same-sector operating revenue share; require exact business mapping and upstream hash
stock_rules.catalyst: signed verified distinct issuer events over 60 exchange sessions; count only, not effect or probability; require complete searched scope and calendar
stock_rules.trend: 20-session corporate-action-consistent stock return less fixed same-sector equal-member basket return; not an entry signal
stock_rules.valuation: PE percentile in1260 cutoff-visible sessions, same profit/pricebasis; positive earnings required
stock_rules.liquidity: median20 sessions turnover CNY; verified unit
stock_rules.evidence: verified required metric fact count / fixed required fact count; gaps not silently excluded

risk.unknown: Total remains NULL; do not interpret UNKNOWN or not-applicable as absence. Financial proxy subtotal separately computed; full risk-screened total requires gates.
risk.sector_company_risks: No customer or leverage gate on sector; evaluate applicable member breadth instead.

universe.name: 铜业务综合生产商样本

selection_basis: Three original engineering anchors + publicly identifiable business peers, before strategy outcomes. Copper basket includes integrated/trading exposure; differences disclosed. Expensive peers retained. No replacements after score/result inspection.

excluded.reason: Automation/software exposure differs from selected HV equipment boundary
Copper smelting oriented alternative not chosen; fixed three-member initial scope avoids post-outcome replacement

limitations: FY2025 group financials lag current events
sector proxy does not implement original demand/supply/orders/policy/global/competition/valuation/RS/risk nine dimensions
gross margin is not competition; no subjective probability
company full scores require all7factors and applicable risk evidence
